rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within 0.1% threshold.
Verifies that summary statistics for all StatisticalVariables match established golden report.
Verifies that all expected geographic entities and places are present in the output observations.
Checks that active programs have recent data within 1 year of current year.

params.query: SELECT * FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('dcid:Amount_Investment', 'dcid:Amount_Investment_EconomicAdjustmentAssistance', 'dcid:Amount_Investment_PublicWorks', 'dcid:Amount_Investment_ProgramPlanning', 'dcid:Amount_Investment_TechnicalAssistance', 'Amount_Investment', 'Amount_Investment_EconomicAdjustmentAssistance', 'Amount_Investment_PublicWorks', 'Amount_Investment_ProgramPlanning', 'Amount_Investment_TechnicalAssistance')
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)

rules.description: Checks that investment amounts are non-negative.
